versions.changelog: fix: add _client.live=True so --live actually routes to polymarket-venue for real USDC trades
Fix apply_skill_config AttributeError for new Simmer SDK compatibility

- Initial release: trades monotonicity violations in NHL hockey O/U ladders and spread-vs-total inconsistencies on Polymarket.
- Automatically discovers, parses, and groups O/U and spread markets for each NHL game.
- Detects broken probability curves—buys/sells where O/U ladder or spread-vs-total is mathematically inconsistent.
- Tunable risk and market filters included; supports live or paper trading via Simmer UI.
- Designed as a template for further strategy extensions, e.g., other leagues or live data feeds.
